# Community result

Add the JSON produced by `python -m s1cogbench package` under `submissions/` and retain the original run locally. Follow [the submission guide](https://github.com/dengzhe-hou/S1CogBench/blob/main/docs/SUBMIT_RESULTS.md).

- [ ] The run uses the original full inputs and scorer for each submitted mode.
- [ ] Checkpoint, code revision, prompt, readout, precision, seeds and hardware are recorded.
- [ ] Infinite, undefined and invalid outcomes retain the original scoring rules.
- [ ] Supporting instructions and permitted evidence are linked in `evidence_url`.
- [ ] No restricted participant inputs, per-item participant outputs, credentials or model weights are included.
- [ ] `python -m s1cogbench check-submissions` passes.

Describe any protocol differences here. A different protocol must not be presented as a matched leaderboard result.

Maintainers review the protocol, denominators and supporting evidence before merge. Passing automated checks alone does not verify a score.
